layout_dets.text: Abstract

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Video matting remains limited by the scale and realism of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: existing datasets. While leveraging segmentation data can

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: enhance semantic stability, the lack of effective boundary

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: supervision often leads to segmentation-like mattes lack-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing fine details. To this end, we introduce a learned Mat-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ting Quality Evaluator (MQE) that assesses semantic and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: boundary quality of alpha mattes without ground truth. It

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: produces a pixel-wise evaluation map that identifies reli-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: able and erroneous regions, enabling ine-grained quality

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: assessment. The MQE scales up video matting in two ways:

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (1) as an online matting-quality feedback during training to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: suppress erroneous regions, providing comprehensive su-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pervision, and (2) as an offline selection module for data

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: curation, improving annotation quality by combining the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: strengths of leading video and image matting models. This

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: process allows us to build a large-scale real-world video

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: matting dataset, VMReal, containing 28K clips and 2.4M

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: frames. To handle large appearance variations in long

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: videos, we introduce a reference-frame training strategy

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: that incorporates long-range frames beyond the local win-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dow for effective training. Our MatAnyone 2 achieves state-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of-the-art performance on both synthetic and real-world

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: benchmarks, surpassing prior methods across all metrics

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 1. Introduction

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Video matting (VM) has gained increasing attention for its

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: broad applications in visual effects and video editing. De-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: spite recent advances [5, 7, 8, 17, 19, 39], existing meth-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ods still suffer from blurry boundaries, missing regions, and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: unstable tracking. A key underlying reason is the limited

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: scale, quality, and realism of existing VM datasets. The

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: †Project lead.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: recent VM800 dataset [39] provides the largest collection

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of video foregrounds, but it contains only 826 sequences

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (~ 1/60 the size of the video object segmentation (VOS)

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dataset used in SAM 2 [27]). To enrich training samples, ex-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: isting pipelines typically composite foregrounds onto ran-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dom backgrounds via RGBA blending. However, such syn-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: thetic data often exhibit inconsistent lighting and unnatural

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: boundaries, leading to a domain gap from real videos that

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: limits model generalization in challenging cases.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: To alleviate data limitations, recent video matting meth-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ods have explored leveraging segmentation priors from pre-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: trained models and large-scale VOS data. (1) Pretrain-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing. Some works employ segmentation models [8] or

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: data [5, 17, 44] for pretraining, followed by finetuning on

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: matting datasets. However, the limited availability of high-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: quality matting data often causes the pretrained segmen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tation capability to degrade during finetuning. (2) Joint-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: training. Some studies [7, 19, 39] instead combine segmen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tation and matting supervision within a unified framework,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: enabling the model to learn both tasks simultaneously.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: However, segmentation data can only provide reliable su-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pervision for non-boundary regions (where alpha values are

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 0 or 1). For boundary regions, MatAnyone [39] applies

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: an unsupervised loss [22] that relies on a strong assump-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion, leading to weak boundary supervision. While this en-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: hances semantic and tracking accuracy, it often causes the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: predicted mattes degrade into segmentation-like masks, es-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pecially around boundaries (see Fig. 1). These methods

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: seek an optimal trade-off between matting and segmenta-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion through balanced data and loss, yet simultaneously im-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: proving semantic accuracy and boundary details remains

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: highly challenging.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: To this end, we introduce a novel Matting Quality Eval-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: uator (MQE) that mitigates the long-standing shortage of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: real VM data and effectively harnesses segmentation infor-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mation. This evaluator operates in two modes: (i) an on-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: line matting-quality guidance during training, and (ii) an

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: offline pixel-wise selection module for data curation, which

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: together scale up video matting training. Given an in-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: put frame, its segmentation mask, and the predicted alpha

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: matte, the evaluator produces a binary evaluation map that

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: identifies “reliable" vs. “erroneous" regions. It implic-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: itly inherits the binary labels of non-boundary regions from

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the input segmentation masks, while assessing fine-detail

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: matting quality in boundary regions leveraging a DINOv3-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: based encoder [30]. This enables the learned MQE to accu-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: rately identify inaccurate or low-quality alpha predictions in

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a pixel-wise manner, thereby providing a comprehensive as-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sessment of both semantic accuracy and detail fidelity (see

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Fig. 4), without requiring ground-truth mattes.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Online Guidance - MQE serves as an online guidance sig-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: nal that provides dynamic supervision through its on-the-fly

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: quality assessment. Specifically, its binary evaluation map

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: acts as a penalty map that encourages the network to correct

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: errors in the erroneous regions. Operating without ground-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: truth mattes (requiring only segmentation masks), MQE of-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fers effective boundary supervision for rich segmentation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: data, thereby enabling large-scale training for matting.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Offline Selection - MQE also serves as an offline selection

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: module for scalable curation of a real-world video mat-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ting dataset. Manual annotation of video alpha mattes is

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: extremely challenging, if not impossible at scale, leaving

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: such a dataset long absent and hindering progress in this

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: field. To overcome this, we design an automated dual-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: branch annotation pipeline, where MQE acts as a quality

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: arbiter to assess and fuse predictions from two comple-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mentary methods: state-of-the-art video and image matting

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: models, which excel in semantic stability and boundary de-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tail, respectively. By selecting reliable regions from each,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the MQE combines their strengths, yielding annotation with

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: both stable semantics and high-quality details. This pipeline

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: constructs VMReal, a large-scale and real-world video mat-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ting dataset with about 28K clips (~ 35× larger than pre-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: vious dataset [39]) and 2.4M annotated frames covering di-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: verse scenes, lighting conditions, and motion patterns.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Moreover, in long videos where subject appearance

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: varies largely over time, propagation-based methods like

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: MatAnyone [39] may fail to matte out new human or

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: clothing parts unseen in earlier frames. Training on short

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sequences cannot model such variations, while long se-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: quences lead to excessive memory overhead. To address

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: this, we introduce a reference-frame strategy that incorpo-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: rates long-range frames beyond the local training window,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: enabling the model to handle large appearance changes

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: across long videos without large memory costs.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In summary, our main contributions are as follows:

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: • We present a learned MQE that performs semantic and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: detail assessment of predicted mattes without ground

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: truth. It functions as both an online guidance signal for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: training and an offline selection module for data curation,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: effectively scaling up video matting.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: • Leveraging the MQE, we construct VMReal, a large-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: scale, scene-diverse, and real-world video matting

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dataset, with about 28K clips and 2.4M annotated frames.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: • We introduce a reference-frame training strategy that ex-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pands the temporal context, allowing our method to han-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dle large appearance variations in long videos efficiently.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Together, these contributions lead to MatAnyone 2, which

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: achieves superior results on both synthetic and real-world

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: benchmarks, surpassing existing methods across all metrics.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: large-scale video object segmentation (VOS) datasets [27,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: real-world videos with dense annotations. While real-world

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and AIM [12] are available, they are limited in scale and,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tency of video matting models. In this work, we construct

layout_dets.text: VMReal, a large-scale real-world video matting dataset, to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: address the data deficiency in the video matting field.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Quality Assessment for Data Curation. Due to the high

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cost of manual annotation, large-scale datasets often rely

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: on model-assisted or fully automated labeling pipelines.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Recent works in image generation [21, 23, 31, 33] and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: restoration [3, 34] employ image quality assessment (IQA)

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: models to construct better-worse data pairs within the Di-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: rect Preference Optimization (DPO) framework, guiding

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: models toward perceptually better results. Also, automatic

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: quality evaluation has been explored in low-level vision

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tasks [3, 16, 34, 37]. For instance, Depth Anything V2 [37]

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: integrates multi-model voting with selective human veri-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fication to ensure annotation reliability, and RORem [16]

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: leverages human feedback to train a discriminator for auto-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: matic high-quality sample selection. These methods assess

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: quality at the image level, whereas video matting demands

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pixel-level and temporally consistent evaluation, motivating

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: our design of a learned MQE for constructing a large-scale

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: video matting dataset.

layout_dets.text: 3. Methodology

layout_dets.text: 3.4. Reference-Frame Strategy for Long Videos

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In long videos, the subject appearance can vary largely over

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: time. Previous MatAnyone [39], which relies on a memory-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: propagation mechanism, often fails to matte out newly ap-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pearing human or clothing parts that were unseen in ear-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: lier frames. This limitation arises because, during train-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing, it is exposed only to short sequences (e.g., 8 frames),

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: where only frames within local window are stored in mem-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ory (Fig. 2(a)), preventing the model from modeling large

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: appearance variations. Simply extending the training win-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dow (e.g., 40 frames [19]) would drastically increase mem-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ory consumption. To overcome this issue, we propose a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: reference-frame strategy that introduces long-range refer-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ence frames into memory beyond the local training window

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (Fig. 2(b)), following the training scheme of [48], thereby

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: extending the temporal context without additional memory

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: overhead. To strengthen the reference-frame strategy, we

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: further apply a random dropout augmentation that randomly

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: masks patches in both RGB and alpha maps, which miti-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: gates over-reliance on historical memory and enhances the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: model's ability to handle unseen regions. This strategy ef-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fectively simulates the challenging large appearance varia-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tions commonly encountered in long videos, leading to im-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: proved stability under challenging scenarios (see Fig. 7).

layout_dets.text: 5. Conclusion

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: We presented MatAnyone 2, a next-generation video mat-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ting framework that integrates a learned Matting Quality

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Evaluator (MQE) for scalable training. The MQE jointly

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: assesses semantic accuracy and boundary detail without

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ground truth, serving as both an online guidance signal and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: an offline data selection module. Leveraging MQE, we fur-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ther constructed VMReal, the first large-scale, real-world

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: video matting dataset with diverse scenes and high-quality

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: annotations. In addition, a reference-frame training strat-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: egy was introduced to handle large appearance variations in

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: long videos. Extensive experiments show that MatAnyone

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2 achieves leading performance on both synthetic and real-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: world benchmarks, significantly improving semantic stabil-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ity, boundary fidelity, and generalization in real scenarios.
